## [1.9.0](https://github.com/mmenzyns/morphe-patches/compare/v1.8.0...v1.9.0) (2026-11-06)

### ✨ New Features

* **alza:** improve compact chart proportions, margin and badge detection ([60e009c](https://github.com/mmenzyns/morphe-patches/commit/60e009c1aac92bbf1c5a5c0ffdda2478a7fa0f63))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **alza:** prevent compact chart overflow on wide price badges and align to right edge ([4baf2bd](https://github.com/mmenzyns/morphe-patches/commit/4baf2bde387511d0195cf1cce111c58faace9cd1))

patches.name: Alza Benefit Prices (CZ / SK)
patches.description: Displays benefit prices and tiers (Gold, Silver, ISIC, Bronze, B2B, Basic) with active promotions and coupons in product detail screen for Czech Republic and Slovakia.

patches.name: Alza Hlídač shopů Price History (CZ / SK)
patches.description: Displays inline price history chart from Hlídač shopů in product detail screen for Czech Republic and Slovakia (alza.cz / alza.sk). Includes compact/large mode replacing HomeCredit installments and settings in Menu.

patches.name: Alza Smart Link Sharing (FxAlza & Clean) (CZ / SK)
patches.description: Enhances shared and copied Alza product links: enables fxalza.cz (or sk.fxalza.cz) domain for rich embeds on Discord and social media, and removes the 'Odesláno z aplikace Alza' promotional text. Configurable in Menu settings.
